issue_context.title: Cannot override `export * from 'mod'` with local value
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

Given:
1. 2 reexports in form of `export * from 'mod'`
2. After code with exports there is a local export with the name equal to one of the reexported from the exports before

This code successfully compiles but throws in runtime.

Changing the order of code when reexports comes after local export fixes the issue.

### Input code

_No response_

### Config

_No response_

### Playground link

https://play.swc.rs/?version=1.2.157&code=H4sIAAAAAAAAA0utKMgvKlHQUkgrys9VUNfTL0ktLtFNVLfm5UrFKpUEkoJLJufnFZeAFTgq2CqYAqUAY95W%2FFEAAAA%3D&config=H4sIAAAAAAAAA0WMSwrDMAxE76K1t93kDj2EcJXg4B8aBWqM714bUrKSmPdmOp3wtHWqrBBdH1o2%2FtJG4hPDa6hGbmoz2jlChiNjPcSWgtdksRTITR2lkMPe1pIvqaoAD%2BJ8xL855lAqn2sFnazVeVcllXyCxjN0lwPet216yfgBCKaI9boAAAA%3D

### Expected behavior

Generated code should not lead to the runtime error.

By the end, generated code should look similar to [this version](https://play.swc.rs/?version=1.2.157&code=H4sIAAAAAAAAA0utKMgvKlFIzs8rLlFIK8rPdVSwVTC15uXi5UqFSGmBhRXU9fRLUotLdBPVrXFJJamD9QEACTaO6lMAAAA%3D&config=H4sIAAAAAAAAA0WMSwrDMAxE76K1t93kDj2EcJXg4B8aBWqM714bUrKSmPdmOp3wtHWqrBBdH1o2%2FtJG4hPDa6hGbmoz2jlChiNjPcSWgtdksRTITR2lkMPe1pIvqaoAD%2BJ8xL855lAqn2sFnazVeVcllXyCxjN0lwPet216yfgBCKaI9boAAAA%3D) or [babel version](https://babeljs.io/repl#?browsers=Chrome%20%3E=%2030&build=&builtIns=false&corejs=false&spec=false&loose=false&code_lz=KYDwDg9gTgLgBAKjgMyhAtnA5AOgPQzADOMAtAIZYDcAUKJLIimprgcWQEbU13jTwAxhAB2JZhgCCcALxwArLSA&debug=false&forceAllTransforms=false&shippedProposals=false&circleciRepo=&evaluate=false&fileSize=false&timeTravel=false&sourceType=unambiguous&lineWrap=true&presets=env,react&prettier=true&targets=Node-10.5&version=7.17.7&externalPlugins=&assumptions=%7B%7D) (Note the `_exportNames` that is empty in the original code for the issue, but filled in the working examples)

### Actual behavior

Runtime error 
```
TypeError: Cannot set property fromA of [object Object] which has only a getter
```

### Version

1.2.157

### Additional context

Might be connected to https://github.com/swc-project/swc/issues/1780

I've made a try to fix it by myself https://github.com/swc-project/swc/pull/4089, please, take a look
